meta.name: process_settings
meta.description: Who may make a process's own value of a resource or a rule active (jav/app/process_settings.py). activation: editor (the person who edits it, or anyone; the owner's choice of 2026-10-24 as the default), owner (only the names listed in owners) or second_person (someone else than who made the draft: four eyes). Retiring a process's own value brings the file's value back.

changelog.note: The first version: the editor makes a value active.
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.
